maddeler.e:
نتوطوط (form IIq)
# نَتَوَطْوَطُ (natawaṭwaṭu) /na.ta.watˤ.wa.tˤu/: first-person plural non-past active indicative of تَوَطْوَطَ (tawaṭwaṭa)
# نَتَوَطْوَطَ (natawaṭwaṭa) /na.ta.watˤ.wa.tˤa/: first-person plural non-past active subjunctive of تَوَطْوَطَ (tawaṭwaṭa)
# نَتَوَطْوَطْ (natawaṭwaṭ) /na.ta.watˤ.watˤ/: first-person plural non-past active jussive of تَوَطْوَطَ (tawaṭwaṭa)
maddeler.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
